import sys, importlib.util
mods=['ortools','z3','pysat','networkx']
for m in mods:
 print(m, importlib.util.find_spec(m))

from ortools.sat.python import cp_model
N=8
cells=range(64)
def rc(k): return divmod(k,N)
adj=[]
allowed=[]
for a in cells:
    ra,ca=rc(a)
    for b in cells:
        if a<b:
            rb,cb=rc(b)
            if sorted([abs(ra-rb),abs(ca-cb)])==[1,2]:
                adj.append((a,b)); allowed.append([a,b]); allowed.append([b,a])
print('edges',len(adj),'allowed tuples',len(allowed))
fixed={0:0,2:27,3:21,10:16,11:1,19:24,21:3,27:51,38:38,50:43,51:60,59:53,61:42}
model=cp_model.CpModel()
x=[model.NewIntVar(0,63,f'x{i}') for i in range(64)]
model.AddAllDifferent(x)
for i,v in fixed.items(): model.Add(x[i]==v)
for i in range(63):
    model.AddAllowedAssignments([x[i],x[i+1]], allowed)
# maybe add inverse vars
pos=[model.NewIntVar(0,63,f'p{c}') for c in range(64)]
model.AddInverse(x,pos)
# positions parity constraint: knight flips square color so cells parity row+col alternates. starting 0 even -> x[t] color=t%2.
for t in range(64):
    # allowed domain maybe via forbidden? x[t] must in color class
    for c in range(64):
        if ((c//8+c%8)&1)!=(t&1):
            model.Add(x[t]!=c)
# fixed already consistent? let's see
print('fixed colors',[(i,v,(v//8+v%8)&1,i&1) for i,v in fixed.items()])
solver=cp_model.CpSolver()
solver.parameters.max_time_in_seconds=60
solver.parameters.num_search_workers=8
solver.parameters.log_search_progress=True
solver.parameters.cp_model_presolve=True
res=solver.Solve(model)
print('res',res, solver.StatusName(res), 'time', solver.WallTime())
if res in (cp_model.OPTIMAL, cp_model.FEASIBLE):
    sol=[solver.Value(v) for v in x]
    print(sol)
    # verify
    print('perm',len(set(sol)), sol[0])
    print('fixed ok', all(sol[i]==v for i,v in fixed.items()))
    print('moves ok', all(tuple(sorted([abs(sol[i]//8-sol[i+1]//8), abs(sol[i]%8-sol[i+1]%8)]))==(1,2) for i in range(63)))
